title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): ‘Concealed’ text field type for sensitive data (New field-level property: MaskType)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces the MaskType field-level property that allows developers to conceal sensitive text field values by default with a toggle to reveal them. This feature works for Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer fields on card and document pages, and supports both desktop and mobile clients.
key_points: MaskType is a new enum property with values None (default) and Concealed that hides field values by default
Users can reveal hidden values through an eye button toggle until the page is refreshed
Only applicable to Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer field types on card or document pages, not repeaters or list pages
MaskType differs from ExtendedDataType Masked property which permanently displays dots and cannot be removed
Cannot be used together with ExtendedDataType Masked, and modifications to MaskType on standard fields may cause publishing errors

quotes.text: Concealed: The client handles this as a concealed field.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the Concealed enum value that activates the masking behavior

quotes.text: List pages or grids do not support this, only document/card pages (not supported in repeaters)
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies important scope limitations developers must understand when implementing MaskType
